title: The 5 Best Yoga Mats for Sensitive Knees
h1: The 5 Best Yoga Mats for Sensitive Knees
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for yoga mats for sensitive knees, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at yoga mats for sensitive knees using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Gaiam Essentials Thick Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 10mm (2/5-inch) NBR foam cushioning, Textured non-slip surface, Easy-cinch carrying strap.
strengths: 10mm is the thickest cushioning in this list, noticeably softer under the knee than standard 3 to 5mm mats
Wide enough surface area to comfortably cushion knees during wide-stance poses too
limitations: Softer foam feels slightly less stable during standing balance poses than denser mats
Cushioning compresses over time with heavy daily use
Bulkier to roll and store than thinner mats

products.name: Manduka PRO Yoga Mat 71-Inch 6mm
products.blurb: Key specs: 6mm dense closed-cell PVC construction, Lifetime guarantee, 26 lbs, stable underfoot.
strengths: Dense foam resists bottoming out under a kneeling knee even though it's thinner than the Gaiam
Holds cushioning quality for years rather than compressing flat like softer foam
Stays stable during standing poses despite the generous cushioning
limitations: 6mm offers less raw thickness than the Gaiam for practitioners who want maximum softness
26 lbs makes it a heavier mat to move around at home

products.name: BalanceFrom GoYoga All-Purpose Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch (6mm) high-density foam, Double-sided non-slip texture, Includes carrying strap.
strengths: 6mm foam gives noticeably more knee comfort than a standard 3 to 4mm studio mat
Cheapest way to test whether extra cushioning actually helps before spending more
Double-sided texture keeps grip reasonable despite the softer surface
limitations: Less cushioning than the Gaiam's 10mm option for the most sensitive knees
Foam compresses and loses support faster than denser rubber over heavy use
Not as stable during standing poses as denser mats at the same thickness

products.name: prAna E.C.O. Yoga Mat
products.blurb: Key specs: 5mm closed-cell natural rubber, Two-sided texturing for grip, Non-toxic, PVC-free construction.
strengths: Dense natural rubber offers more support under the knee than soft foam at the same thickness
Two-sided grip stays reliable even as extra padding is added underneath
PVC-free build appeals to practitioners with material sensitivities beyond just knee comfort
limitations: 5mm is less cushioning than the Gaiam's 10mm for maximum knee relief
Best paired with a folded towel for practitioners needing extra kneeling support

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
